Hi all —

Thanks for the clear summary, Jamie and Marissa. Short answer: we can support a pilot with near-zero retention for request/response content, with some operational constraints and contract-level controls. Summary of proposal below.

What we can offer for a time-limited pilot (30 days unless otherwise agreed):
1) Request/Response Content: 0-retention mode — request and response payloads will be processed in-memory and not written to persistent storage. No content will be retained beyond the processing lifecycle. This covers transcripts and generated responses.

2) Operational Logs: we can provide reduced operational logging for troubleshooting and SRE needs. The proposed default for the pilot is 7 days of retention for operational logs, with automatic redaction of PII fields. Logs will be limited to metadata and anonymized error traces (no full request bodies). We can shorten to 0 days (rolling) only with an explicit acceptance of limited debugability (support sessions will require temporary, customer-approved trace captures).

3) Data Residency: we will route and process all traffic through our US-only region for the pilot and ensure encryption-in-transit + customer-managed KMS for keys where requested.

4) Controls & Audit: we will capture the retention exception in an addendum to the SOW and include acceptance criteria. We will provide SOC 2 evidence and a short technical runbook describing redaction and in-memory processing.

Attachments: Retention_Schedule_Proposed.xlsx (proposed schedule with options 0 / 7 / 30 days)

Caveats & Notes:
- 0-retention for content means we cannot replay customer interactions for debugging; any troubleshooting that requires payloads will need explicit, time-limited capture by the customer or via a signed short-lived capture request (DocuSign link below for approval template).
- For any rollouts beyond the pilot, we'll need to formalize changes in the contract and likely include a security review with your SOC2 artifact exchange.

Next steps:
- If this matches FinTechCo's needs, Marissa and I can draft the SOW addendum and attach the retention schedule.
- Please confirm whether you want "7 days (redacted logs)" or "0 days (rolling, limited debugability)" for operational logs for the pilot.
- Proposed sync: Mon 11/23 10:00 AM PT — I will set up a 20-minute call if that works.

Marissa / Camila — I'll prepare the addendum draft and the runbook this week.

Best,
